body: Coordinator, quick pass (read, not built): the PR merges cleanly with `main`. The author's quick gate is green on the head 2aa9ea562 (13 steps, 0 failed), clippy for `camcraft-ui` is clean, and the pinning tests are named. The body is complete. The PR goes to ready for the independent review. The change is click routing with no visible layout change, so the PR has no screenshots.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2aa9ea562f0dac82e9ad9cffee144aee79ea745a -->
**Verdict: clean. No blockers.** Label: `merge-ready`.

## What looks good

1. **The fix** (`crates/ui/src/interact.rs:150-153`). `feature_routed` also returns true while `state.boundary_pick.is_some()`. This is one line and it is minimal. It uses the same rule as the WCS role draft and the start/exit pick.
   - `feature_click::ask` (`crates/ui/src/feature_click.rs:117-121`) already gives faces and edges, and no points, for an armed Boundary row in every mode (#1727). A point is refused by name (`feature_click.rs:243-247`). The route and the pick rule now agree.
   - The change applies to all Boundary rows (Include, Exclude, an extra entry, the open boundary, "Do not touch"). This is correct: all of them already take faces and edges by `ask`. Before the fix, each of them selected the whole model in Models mode.
   - The row cannot stay armed by mistake after the group goes. `boundary_pick` is cleared when the group closes (`egui_app/boundary.rs:72-76`), when the kind has no area (`boundary.rs:64-66`), when "Do not touch" is not supported (`boundary.rs:309-311`), by "Done" and by Reset (`boundary.rs:190`), when the page is not an operation (`egui_app/pages.rs:100-102`), and when the editor closes (`state.rs:3076`).
2. **The command law.** The click writes the draft only (`interact::queue_boundary_pick` -> `boundary_draft::take_pick`). Apply commits it as one undoable `EditOperationParams::with_area` (`boundary_draft.rs:11`). The PR adds no direct write to a document field.
3. **The tests** (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch_click.rs`, 111 lines, registered in `egui_app/tests.rs:186-187`).
   - They send real pointer events through the shell route (`interact::pick_at` -> `feature_click::click`).
   - They assert the rows, the feature kind (face, then edge), the status text and the remove button. Positions are used only to aim the click.
   - The red output before the fix is on #3335 (`a face click adds one row: [] / selected guard`).
   - The diff only adds tests. No test is removed and no snapshot PNG changes.
4. **Code shape.** There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The decision file has the heading, Decided, Why, Dropped and Cost to change, as `docs/decisions/README.md` tells.
5. **The PR body** is complete: what changed, the readings, the pinning tests, the runs, "Not exercised", `Changelog:` and `Fixes #3335`. It says that the layout did not change and that there is no screenshot for this reason.
6. **Heavy lanes.** The diff reaches no heavy lane. `xtask/src/plan.rs:190` sets `HEAVY_CRATES` to `kernel`, `motion` and `app`. The diff changes only `camcraft-ui` files and one Markdown file. No heavy crate depends on `camcraft-ui`.

## Runner results

Run: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45014924751 (`pr-test.yml`). It built the trial merge of 2aa9ea562 with main 62353ac75. The conclusion is `failure`.

- Quick gate: 13 steps, 1 failed. The build passed. 11 ui suites passed: boundary, boundary_picks, catalog_render, contour_dxf_sketch, edge_loop_pick, operations, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool.
- ui lib: `1427 passed; 1 failed; 7 ignored`.
  - The two new tests ran and passed: `egui_app::tests::do_not_touch_click::do_not_touch_takes_viewport_clicks_in_models_mode ... ok` and `egui_app::tests::do_not_touch_click::do_not_touch_takes_a_face_and_an_edge_by_viewport_click ... ok`.
  - The one red test is `egui_app::post_dialog_tests::desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably`. This is the known red of main (#3384). Post-merge run 45012856242 on 887d8da2a shows it on main without this PR, and PR #3307 caused it. It is not caused by this PR.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` finished with no warning. The step is green.
- The two app tests that are red on main (`blind_slot::blind_slot_pocket_family_cuts_from_end_wall_to_stock_edge` and `corner_relief_safety::adaptive2d_spiral_and_offset2d_support_relief_while_trochoidal_and_do_not_touch_refuse`, post-merge run 45013742033 on 92935735e, from PR #3108) are not in this run. The quick gate ran `camcraft-ui` steps only. This PR changes only `camcraft-ui` files, so these reds are not caused by it.

## Blockers

None.

## Notes (not blockers)

- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` has 1842 lines (1837 before). The file was already over the 400-line rule before this PR. This PR adds 5 lines, and 4 of them are a comment. A split of the file is separate work.
- Escape does not disarm a Boundary row. Only "Done", a group close, a page change or an editor close does. This behaviour was there before this PR, and it is not a regression.
- The other Boundary rows in Models mode have no test of their own, as the PR body says. They use the same route and the same `ask` rule.
